difficulty_reason: The lemma records that a map of complexes induces a natural transformation between the derived tensor product functors, and that a quasi-isomorphism induces an isomorphism of functors, and the proof is a 9-line argument that uses the K-flat presentation of the functors. Because the derived tensor product is computed by evaluating on K-flat complexes, the transformation is defined simply by totalising the tensor product of a fixed K-flat complex with the given map, and the second statement then follows from the statement that tensoring with a K-flat complex preserves quasi-isomorphisms. The two steps are the presentation of the functors and the invariance statement, both quoted from the same section.
